latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Dagster Pipeline Analyzer

- Analyze Dagster pipelines and software-defined assets for quality, scheduling, partitioning, IO managers, resource configuration, and observability.
- Audits asset dependencies, freshness policies, group structure, sensor/schedule configuration, and operational best practices.
- Provides actionable checks and best-practice recommendations on asset graph design, partitioning, IO manager selection, resource security, and observability.
- Outputs a health score with a per-category breakdown, critical issue highlights, and remediation code examples.
- Suitable for code review, deployment audits, partition optimization, and observability improvements in any Dagster project.
